text:
ashley: Heads up — after last night's kernel switch (packed-gemm -> fused-attn-v2) we saw p95 latency regress ~18% on short prompts. Seems tied to batch formation for <64-token prompts. Profiling dump below, cc @sasha :eyes:

ashley: profiler top lines (hosted-prod-3)
```
  sample_count: 1200
  mean_token_decode_ms: 5.6
  p50_total_ms: 42
  p95_total_ms: 110  <-- up from 93
  kv_hit_rate: 0.81  <-- down from 0.92 last week
  avg_batch_size_tokens: 84
  avg_requests_per_batch: 2.3
```

marc: ack. interesting that kv_hit_rate dropped. did the kernel change affect KV lookup latency or our cache stamping? :thinking_face:

sasha: I ran a quick microprobe on dev and saw similar behaviour when decode-rate classifier bins put short-high-rt callers into same cohort as medium-length low-rt ones. The classifier thresholds ended up creating "mosaic" cohorts that prevented stable batch fill.

sasha: local probe output
```
  decode_rate_bins(ms_per_token): [8, 20, 45]  # was [10,30,60]
  cohort_assignments: short-fast -> cohort-A, short-slow -> cohort-B, medium -> cohort-C
  batch_formation_policy: hold_until_tokens_or_ms (default)
```

vikram: could be two effects: 1) kernel lowered per-token throughput variance, so our decode-rate thresholds misclassify bursts, 2) KV cache stampedes when small batches cause duplicate cache fills. Both would reduce kv_hit_rate and increase tail.

marc: suggestion: try raising token_budget_per_batch for short prompt cohorts to 256 tokens and reduce min_hold_ms from 8 -> 4 for short-fast cohort so they can merge quicker. Also consider merging decode-rate bins to [12,40] to avoid the mosaic effect.

ashley: plan proposal:
- tweak classifier thresholds to decode_rate_bins: [12,40]
- set batcher.short_cohort.token_budget_per_batch=256
- enable aggressive prefix-KV coalescing for small batches (kv.coalesce_window_ms=20)
- run 12h AB against prod canary (10% traffic)

sasha: test config (use canary tag):
```
  ./infra/run_probe.sh --canary-tag=mosaic-fix --classifier-bins="12,40" \
    --batcher.short.token_budget=256 --batcher.short.min_hold_ms=4 \
    --kv.coalesce_window_ms=20
```

perf-bot: benchmark summary uploaded: https://grafana.redwood/prod/boards/infra?panel=kv_decode_v2 (auto)
deploy-bot: canary deployed: mosaic-fix -> rs=3 (region us-west-2), traffic=10% :rocket:

marc: I'll own the AB and watch p95/p99 + kv_hit metrics. Quick sanity check: we should also monitor kernel fallback count (fused-attn-v2 -> packed-gemm) — that increased slightly after the rollout last night.

sasha: +1. I'll also dump batch composition histograms on the canary every 5m: average_requests_per_batch, avg_tokens_per_batch, cohort_entropy. If entropy spikes that's a sign of mosaic cohorts.

vikram: if AB looks good, follow-up to harden: add a small RL-based policy to adjust decode bins every 30m based on recent p95 and kv_hit so we don't regress when kernels change. But starting with static tweaks is fine.

ashley: thanks all. marc/sasha please post the AB results by EOD and we can roll to 50% if stable. I'll open a follow-up to track a regression test that simulates kernel selection switches (kernel-flip test) against batching classifier.

marc: on it. :thumbsup:

sasha: running first probe now, will post logs here shortly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ashley: cheers — tag me when you see p95 < 100 and kv_hit > 0.88 on the canary.
